【原视频简介】
MiniMax H3 is here — but how good is it really, and can it compete with Seedance 2.5?
 
In this video, I’m putting MiniMax H3 through a series of completely different AI video tests to see where the model shines, where it struggles, and how its results compare with one of the strongest AI video models right now.

We’ll test how MiniMax H3 handles recognizable TV show aesthetics, cinematic openings, videos with generated text, realistic characters and environments, product ads, and motion design.

Each test focuses on a different challenge — from maintaining visual consistency and creating believable movement to handling typography, commercial-style visuals, complex compositions, and polished motion.

Along the way, we’ll compare the results with Seedance 2.5 to see how MiniMax H3 performs across different use cases and whether it can genuinely stand as a strong new competitor in AI video generation.
